shadows.name: ambient-lift
shadows.purpose: Soft ambient elevation for the terminal and login card only.

motion.name: ease-color
motion.purpose: Color/border transitions on hover. No transforms.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single solid action — Open app, Sign in with GitHub.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 46px; padding: 0 22px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9px; background: #0a0a0a; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Geist Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #3f3f46; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0a0a0a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: The quiet secondary action beside the primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 46px; padding: 0 22px; border: 1px solid #d4d4d4; border-radius: 9px; background: transparent; color: #0a0a0a; font-family: 'Geist Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #0a0a0a; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0a0a0a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: State and success reported in Merge Green — running, open, merged.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: #eaf5ee; color: #10632a; font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; } .ds-badge-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #1a7f37; }

components.name: Terminal
components.description: Signature component: the sandbox session that proves the flow — prompt-led, mono, green on success.
components.html:
nixx — sandboxrunning

$ nixx run "implement rate limiting"

▸ sandbox provisioned (isolated)

▸ sandbox-worker executing…

✓ opened pull request #42
components.css: .ds-terminal { border: 1px solid #e7e7e7; border-radius: 12px; background: #f6f6f6; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.04), 0 16px 40px -20px rgba(0,0,0,0.25); font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-terminal-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e7e7e7; background: #fafafa; } .ds-dots { display: inline-flex; gap: 6px; } .ds-dots i { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: #d4d4d4; } .ds-terminal-title { flex: 1; font-size: 12px; color: #71717a; text-align: center; } .ds-terminal-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 12px; color: #71717a; } .ds-status-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #1a7f37; } .ds-terminal-body { padding: 18px; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.95; color: #0a0a0a; } .ds-terminal-body p { margin: 0 0 6px; } .ds-prompt { color: #71717a; } .ds-muted { color: #71717a; } .ds-ok { color: #3f3f46; } .ds-check { color: #10632a; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Login Card
components.description: The centered authentication surface for the GitHub sign-in flow.
components.html:
Sign in to Nixx

Connect your GitHub account to run coding tasks in an isolated sandbox.
components.css: .ds-card { max-width: 400px; padding: 40px 36px; border: 1px solid #e7e7e7; border-radius: 16px; background: #f6f6f6; text-align: center; box-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.03), 0 16px 40px -24px rgba(0,0,0,0.22); font-family: 'Geist Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 10px; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #0a0a0a; } .ds-card-sub { margin: 0 0 28px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; color: #3f3f46; } .ds-card .ds-btn-primary { width: 100%; }

narrative.overview: Nixx presents itself the way serious engineering infrastructure does: a monochrome surface of ink on paper, where the only color is the signal. One reserved green — GitHub's merge green — marks state and success, and its rarity is what makes it mean something. The signature surface is the terminal: monospace, prompt-led, honest about what is running and what has completed. The system is professional and calm by construction — no gradients, no glass, no decorative motion.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome ink-on-paper with one state-green accent, used sparingly.
Self-hosted Geist Sans / Geist Mono; mono reserved for real data.
Hairline borders and flat surfaces; soft ambient elevation only on the signature objects.
Light and dark themes, both native to the same tokens via prefers-color-scheme.
Minimal motion: color shifts only, no transforms or entrance choreography.

rules.name: The Merge-Green Rule
rules.body: The green accent appears only to report state or success — running, open, merged — and never exceeds ~10% of any screen. Its rarity is the signal.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-Data Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono appears only where there is real data — code, commands, hashes, status, numerals — never as decorative technical dressing.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Elevation belongs to the two signature objects and nowhere else.

dos: Do keep the surface monochrome; let the single Merge Green carry all state and success.
Do use Geist Mono for code, commands, hashes, status, and numerals — real data only.
Do keep hairline (1px) borders for separation and hairline-strong only for emphasis.
Do cap line measure at 54–58ch for running copy.
Do support both light and dark via prefers-color-scheme, using the same token names.
donts: Don't introduce gradients, glass, or blur — the system is flat and paper-like.
Don't add hover transforms, entrance animations, or scale/lift effects; motion is color-only and ≤150ms.
Don't use emoji or unicode glyphs in place of drawn SVG icons outside the terminal's own output.
Don't add a second accent color; a second hue would break the 'green means state' contract.
Don't use shadow on anything but the terminal and the login card.
